findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: A non-development caller can observe a nil cache under the read lock, release it, and then wait while another caller successfully populates the cache. Once it acquires the write lock, it unconditionally rereads the manifest and overwrites the already-populated cache. Under concurrent initial requests this serializes one filesystem manifest read per caller; additionally, a later transient read failure can replace a valid cached value with nil. After acquiring the write lock, return the cache when `cfg.Env != setting.Dev` and it has been populated, while preserving the reload behavior for development mode.
